answer: A farm cannot pad a short template to fit, because the duplicate check runs on the padded text and the beacon band is published for each class. The length band is a cap tied to the mechanism class, 187 to 249 characters here, and an answer outside it is rejected as padded or truncated before the thread identity is graded at all. Since the measured length is checked against the declared class, the oasis audit records the value and keeps the rejection reason. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
